description: This file contains utility functions for preprocessing ImageNet data and decoding predictions, including input normalization for different modes and data formats, as well as functions for decoding model predictions and validating input shapes.

methods.name: _preprocess_numpy_input
methods.description: Preprocesses a Numpy array encoding a batch of images for different modes and data formats.

methods.name: _preprocess_symbolic_input
methods.description: Preprocesses a tensor encoding a batch of images for different modes and data formats.

methods.name: preprocess_input
methods.description: Preprocesses a tensor or Numpy array encoding a batch of images, handling both symbolic tensors and numpy arrays.

methods.name: decode_predictions
methods.description: Decodes the predictions of an ImageNet model into class labels and descriptions.

methods.name: _obtain_input_shape
methods.description: Utility to compute and validate a model's input shape based on various parameters.
